_README: Per-client Amazon SP campaign UPDATE change-set. Copy to config.UPDATE.<client>-<market>.json (gitignored; only this TEMPLATE is committed). Unlike create mode, every row this produces points at a REAL live entity, so uploading the result WILL change, pause or archive real campaigns. Run: python3 tools/amazon-campaign-builder/update_campaigns.py --config <this file> --preflight → --preview (plain-English list of every planned change, writes nothing) → then without a flag to build. Output is a FILE plus a mandatory _REVIEW.md; uploading it in Campaign Manager > Bulk Operations is a separate operator-confirmed action.
_IDS: Every ID below comes from `export_file` and nowhere else. Amazon bulksheets IDs are purely numeric; anything with a non-digit is rejected as a temp ID. Never take an ID from the console UI, a screenshot, or a previous session's memory, and re-download the export before each batch because a stale one gets IDs and current values wrong.
brand: <Brand for the output filename, e.g. Acme>
export_file: <path to a bulksheets download of the 'Sponsored Products Campaigns' tab, e.g. downloads/acme/ads/acme-us-bulk-2026-08-02.xlsx>

changes._note: Delete every section you are not using. A placeholder left in place fails preflight by design rather than shipping a row you did not mean. Archives cascade: archiving a campaign covers its ad groups, keywords, targets and negatives, and the builder skips the children instead of writing redundant rows. No-op changes (setting a field to what it already is) are dropped and reported as SKIPPED.

campaigns._note: One entry per campaign to edit. Omit any field you are not changing. state: enabled|paused. bidding_strategy: Down only|Up and down|Fixed bids. placements are whole-number percentages, 0 clears the adjustment. end_date sets a date; clearing an existing one needs clear_end_date true AND allow_end_date_clear true above, because an accidental clear silently un-ends a campaign. A campaign that belongs to a portfolio keeps its Portfolio ID automatically, so an update never drops it out of the portfolio.

ad_groups._note: Omit any field you are not changing. state: enabled|paused.
ad_groups.ad_group_id: <numeric Ad Group ID from the export>

product_ads._note: pause/enable take bare Ad IDs from the fresh export. Use this when the campaign exists but a product ad child needs its state corrected.

keywords._note: pause/enable/archive take bare Keyword IDs. `replace` archives the old keyword and creates its replacement in the same ad group, which is how you change a keyword's text or match type: Amazon has no edit for either. `add` attaches new keywords to an EXISTING campaign and ad group. match_type: EXACT|BROAD|PHRASE.

add.ad_group_id: <numeric Ad Group ID from the export>

negatives._note: Campaign-level negatives can only be archived. A paused ad-group negative may be enabled by real Keyword ID. `add` level: campaign|ad_group; leave level empty and it infers ad_group when an ad_group_id is present, campaign when it is not. match_type: NEGATIVE_EXACT|NEGATIVE_PHRASE.

targets._note: Product targeting (PAT). pause/enable/archive take bare Product Targeting IDs from the fresh export. `expanded` true writes asin-expanded="...", false writes asin="...".

add.ad_group_id: <numeric Ad Group ID from the export>
